newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Italy's Tecnimont in Saudi petchem deal.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Tecnimont in Saudi petchem deal.

text.p: The Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Co (SAFCO) said on Monday it signed a letter of intent with Tecnimont of Italy to build ammonia and urea plants in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail.

A SAFCO statement said under the deal, signed on Monday in Riyadh, the ammonia plant will have production capacity of 500,000 tonnes a year and the urea plant will have capacity of 600,000 tonnes annually.
It did not give the cost of the project.
SAFCO, 41 percent owned by the Saudi Basic Industries Corp, said the project was expected to take 28 months to complete from the signing and will go on stream before the end of 1999.
SAFCO's Chairman and Managing Director Mohammad al-Mady said he expected the new project would be financed by SAFCO, the Saudi Industrial Development Fund and commercial banks.
When completed, the plants will raise the annual capacity of SAFCO plants at Jubail and Dammam to 1.2 million tonnes of ammonia and more than 1.5 million tonnes of urea, Mady said.
